eras.title: Before CDID
eras.summary: A 2024 community article traces the project to a 2019 hobby game. Roblox records show the creator's account 'pengemudiindo' building Indonesian driving places from April 2020, and the original 'Car Driving Indonesia' place opening on 30 October 2020.

eras.title: Classic CDID
eras.summary: The numbered classic builds (V1, V2.5, the V3.3 Village Edition, V3.5, V4 and V4.5) all ran on the original place, 5896294709. Exact release dates were never published, but the place record, its promotional images and community archives survive.

eras.title: The Revamp
eras.summary: The old group's places were removed in May 2021. On 5 June 2021 a new experience opened under CDID Studio Official Group, and version numbers started again from V0.x.

eras.title: Modern CDID
eras.summary: Continuous updates added Central Java, East Java, Bali, a modification system, game passes, seasonal events and thousands of cars, reaching V2.8 in November 2026.

entries.title: 'Esofania': the reported beginning
entries.description: A community article published in 2024 says the project began in 2019 as a hobby game called 'Esofania', made by a player known as 'beforiest', and later grew into Car Driving Indonesia. No 2019 Roblox record has been found to confirm this. The name resembles the 'ndesovania' label on the earliest surviving build (below), and a Roblox account in the CDID team owns a place called 'Beforiest's Place Number: 80'. We have not confirmed these refer to the same person.

media.caption: No 2019 media or Roblox record has been found.

entries.title: City of Snow Shoreside
entries.description: The earliest public place on the account 'pengemudiindo', which later owned the original CDID group. It is a 'slot' driving game: 'buy your slots to the owner to feel how you drive in the snow.' It is not CDID, but it is the earliest surviving driving project from the same account.

media.caption: City of Snow Shoreside, official place icon.

entries.title: The 'Death Road' projects
entries.description: On 14 June 2020 the same account created 'Bolivia Death Road (Coming Soon.)', described as 'The next Indonesian Death Road.' That wording implies an earlier 'Indonesian Death Road' project existed, but no place by that name from 2020 survives. In April 2021 the CDID developer Hariaall published 'Indonesia Death Road (REMASTERED)' (ver 1.7, over 3.4 million visits).

media.caption: Indonesia Death Road (REMASTERED), 2021: a blue taxi MPV on a jungle road.
Indonesia Death Road (REMASTERED): night driving with traffic and a box truck.

entries.title: GrandMini Games Studio
entries.description: The Roblox group GrandMini Games Studio still describes itself as the 'Car Driving Indonesia Official Group'. It is owned by 'pengemudiindo', the same account that owns the original Car Driving Indonesia place (5896294709), and CDID developer Hariaall holds its Co-Owner role. Its earliest place was created on 25 July 2020, and all its places are now deleted. The site owner reports that 'Grandmini' is associated with the alleged duplication of V4. Roblox's ownership records point the other way, so that link is recorded as disputed. See the V4 chapter.

media.caption: The group's places were deleted; no thumbnails remain on Roblox.

entries.title: 'The oldest CDID I could ever find'
entries.description: In April 2021, CDID developer Hariaall uploaded a build titled 'oldest cdid i could ever find in my folder', described only as 'indonesia death road/ ndesovania'. Its screenshots show an early map with a fuel station, two-lane highway, village houses, Indonesian 'B' plates and a basic on-screen HUD. When the build was originally made is not stated.

media.caption: Hatchback on an early two-lane road, with hills in the background.
A fuel station from the earliest surviving build.
Truck traffic past village houses.
The early in-game HUD and a crashed car.
Hatchback showcase render with plate 'B5EVF3'.
Saloon showcase render with an Indonesian 'B' plate.

entries.title: 'old cdid'
entries.description: A place named 'old cdid', created on the 'pengemudiindo' account on 25 November 2020 and last updated in July 2021. It has no description and Roblox no longer serves its images, but the name shows that by late 2020 'CDID' was already the game's identity.

media.caption: Roblox no longer serves this place's thumbnail.

entries.title: The original Car Driving Indonesia place
entries.description: Place 5896294709 was created on 30 October 2020 by the account 'pengemudiindo'. It became the home of classic CDID, with 5.5 million visits and 24,195 favourites, far more than any other classic-era place. Videos from 2020–21 link to it as 'Car Driving Indonesia' and 'Update Car Driving Indonesia Village Edition'. Today it is titled '(CLOSED) Car Driving Indonesia', with the description 'We're closing for a moment, Sorry!'.

media.caption: 'Gerbang CDID' toll gate, with trucks and cars.
'Jalan Tol': the classic toll road.
'PaintShop': a 'Paint Bodywork' garage.

entries.title: Car Driving Indonesia V1
entries.description: Community 'Evolution of CDID' compilations begin with a V1 build. No V1 changelog or place survives in a source we could open.

entries.dateLabel: Original date not verified · archived 4 August 2021
entries.title: V2.5: highways and toll gates
entries.description: V2.5 survives as an archive place republished by CDID developer Hariaall. Its images show a multi-lane toll highway with heavy traffic, concrete barriers and buses queuing at a toll gate. Those toll roads are still central to the game today.

media.caption: V2.5: a traffic jam on the toll highway.
V2.5: buses at a toll gate.

entries.title: Village Edition (V3.3)
entries.description: 'Car Driving Indonesia : Village Edition', branded 'CDID : VE', moved the action to village roads lined with fields and featured Indonesian staples such as the Avanza and Kijang Innova. The surviving place (5.8 million visits) was created on 28 January 2021. Period YouTube videos link to the Village Edition on the original CDID place (5896294709).

media.caption: 'CDID : VE', the Village Edition icon.
'NEW CAR': a white Avanza-style MPV promoted in the Village Edition.
MPVs on a village road.
Cars at a zebra crossing, with a taxi.

media.title: Roblox Car Driving Indonesia: Village Edition Live

entries.dateLabel: Original date not verified · archived 4 August 2021
entries.title: V3.5
entries.description: V3.5 survives as an archive place republished by CDID developer Hariaall with the note 'Here's the another version you want to discover.' No V3.5 changelog was found, and Roblox no longer serves the place's screenshots.

media.caption: V3.5 screenshots are no longer served by Roblox. No verified V3.5 footage was found.

entries.dateLabel: Early 2021 · V4.5 images uploaded 28 Apr – 17 May 2021
entries.title: CDID V4 and V4.5 on the original place
entries.description: V4 and V4.5 were the last classic builds on the original place (5896294709). Its surviving promotional images, branded 'CDID V4.5', announce a new CDID Mall with interior, New TipenLand, new and reworked cars, and a map expansion towards 'Desa Cigunung'. Earlier shots show a 'Gerbang CDID' toll gate, a paint shop and toll roads. The V4.5 images were uploaded between 28 April and 17 May 2021, so the game was still being updated weeks before it disappeared. The original V4 changelog text has not survived on this place. A V4 changelog (new cars and trucks, reworked map and Jakarta, new UI, police jobs, new highway) survives only on a separate V4-labelled place, 6267849935, which is not the original.

media.caption: The 'CDID V4.5' icon of the original place.
'New CDID Mall With Interior' (V4.5 promotional image).
'New TipenLand' (V4.5 promotional image).
'New Cars' (V4.5 promotional image).
'Reworked Cars' (V4.5 promotional image).
'New Map Expansion': Desa Cigunung, 15 km.

entries.title: Motorcycles in classic CDID
entries.description: A contributed screenshot shows a classic-style buy menu with a 'MotorBike' category offering a 'Vario' and a 'PC-X' scooter, listed below cars named with real brands ('2008 Toyota Vios Taxi'). Today's CDID uses parody brand names, which fits a pre-revamp build. The screenshot's original source (video, upload date and game version) has not been documented, so it is community-reported evidence rather than confirmation. No changelog or developer post we could access mentions motorcycles, and the V4 changelog text (preserved only on a separate V4-labelled copy) lists only cars, trucks and a planned bus. A community video titled about riding a racing motorbike to the mall links to the original CDID place 5896294709. The current CDID catalogue contains no motorcycles.

media.caption: 'MotorBike' section of a classic buy menu: Vario and PC-X scooters, below a '2008 Toyota Vios Taxi'. Zoomed frame from footage; the original source and version are not documented.

media.title: Aku Ke MALL Naik Motor Racing - Roblox Indonesia

entries.title: 'CDID is back'
entries.description: The current experience (place 6911148748) was created at 01:58 UTC on 5 June 2021 under the new, verified CDID Studio Official Group. The Luxury Car and Luxury House game passes followed about two hours later. Its description announces that 'Car Driving Indonesia (CDID) is back'. Version numbering started again, and the earliest logged revamp build is V0.3. Community sources call this new game 'CDID V5' (see the V4 chapter).

media.caption: The current CDID icon (V2.8, Halloween 2026 edition).

entries.title: Early revamp game passes
entries.description: Game-pass creation dates trace the early revamp: Emergency Vehicle (30 July 2021), Custom Radio Access (8 August 2021), then Additional Ownable Car, Custom Color and Custom Plate (22 December 2021).

entries.title: The classic builds are preserved
entries.description: Two months after the relaunch, CDID developer Hariaall republished V2.5 and V3.5 as archive places, cross-linked with the Village Edition (V3.3). Together these places have over 7 million visits, which is why classic CDID can still be played.

entries.title: Retro cars and the jobs economy
entries.description: The Retro Car, 2x Paycheck and +50% Job Earning passes were created on the same day. This marks retro cars as a dedicated category and the start of paid boosts for job income.

entries.title: Into Central Java
entries.description: V0.6 added the Jawa Tengah map (phase 1: Palimanan, Cirebon, Tegal, Pekalongan), 114 new vehicles, a new main menu and UI, the car modification system, reworked Sentul and Villa roads, more car slots and the Rare Imports pass. The pass was created on 28 June 2022, and V0.6.5 brought Independence Day (August) limited cars.

media.title: REVIEW LENGKAP Update Besar Jawa Tengah di CDID

entries.title: HUT RI 78
entries.description: Added 30 new cars and 3 special cars, an event for Indonesia's 78th Independence Day, and new modification options (lights, horn and reset).

entries.title: CDID REMASTERED (BETA)
entries.description: The CDID Studio owner's account created a separate 'CDID REMASTERED (BETA)' place, alongside earlier experiments such as 'Cipularang' (2021) and 'CDID-Project Traffic Racer (BETA)' (2022). These places received few visits, and none replaced the main game.

entries.title: Version 2 and the Bali map
entries.description: Added the Bali map, a new modification and speedometer UI, a private-server panel, 76 new and reworked cars and a Ramadhan quest. The Advanced Modification pass was created on 28 March 2025, which fits that timing.

entries.title: Jawa Timur unlocked
entries.description: Opened East Java (Ngawi, Kediri, Surabaya, Sidoarjo, Malang) and introduced the Weekly Car Drop.

entries.title: Bali Phase 1 and the gacha system
entries.description: The current version: 92 new and reworked cars, Halloween 2026, a reworked Office Job, the Bali Phase 1 refresh and a new gacha system.

media.caption: Halloween 2026 key art.

gaps: No surviving source shows CDID existing in 2019. The earliest dated record is April 2020, on the creator's personal account.
Classic-era dealership locations, menus and vehicle lists are not documented in any source we could access.
Motorcycles are supported only by a contributed screenshot of a classic buy menu (origin and version not documented). No changelog or developer post confirms when they were added or removed.
Official Discord announcements from 2020–2021 could not be read, because channel access needs a Discord login.
The Internet Archive and direct YouTube pages could not be reached from our research environment. Videos are therefore identified from search-engine listings and embedded as community footage.
Release dates for V1, V2.5, V3.3, V3.5, V4 and V4.5 were never published. Only place creation dates and image-upload windows are known.
The exact date the original place closed is not in Roblox's public records. Its 'updated' timestamp (7 March 2025) reflects a later edit.
Who 'Lemon' was, the duplicate's name and ID, and whether Roblox removed it are unknown.
The TikTok reference by @beeforiel and the 2024 community blog could not be opened from our research environment. Only search-engine summaries were available.

incident.title: The Disappearance of CDID V4
incident.subtitle: May 2021
incident.intro: In May 2021 the classic Car Driving Indonesia stopped being playable. Three weeks later, CDID returned as a new game under a new studio group. Community accounts tie the break to an alleged duplication of the game by someone called 'Lemon'. This chapter separates what Roblox's own records prove from what the community remembers, and from what remains unknown.

sections.heading: Historical background of CDID V4
sections.label: Verified
body: The original Car Driving Indonesia place (5896294709) was created on 30 October 2020 by the account 'pengemudiindo'. It grew to 5.5 million visits and 24,195 favourites through the Village Edition and the V4 updates.

Its last surviving promotional images, branded 'CDID V4.5', were uploaded between 28 April and 17 May 2021. They show a new mall, TipenLand, new and reworked cars and a map expansion, so the game was still in active development weeks before it disappeared.

media.caption: 'CDID V4.5' icon, original place.
'New CDID Mall With Interior'.

sections.heading: The reported disappearance on 17 May 2021
sections.label: Verified
body: Community sources, including the 2024 Farrelpee blog and, per the site owner, the @beeforiel TikTok, say the game 'suddenly disappeared' on 17 May 2021.

Roblox's records independently show activity on exactly that date. The GrandMini Games Studio group's original place was last updated on 17 May 2021, three more group places were created and updated that day, and the last public place on the 'pengemudiindo' account was also updated on 17 May. All the group's places are now deleted.
The date is therefore corroborated by primary records. What happened on that day, and why, is not recorded.

sections.heading: What happened to the original experience
sections.label: Verified
body: The original place was not deleted. It still exists, owned by 'pengemudiindo', titled '(CLOSED) Car Driving Indonesia' with the message 'We're closing for a moment, Sorry!'. It has no active servers, and a direct lookup returns it as unavailable.

Whether it was closed by its owner or restricted by Roblox, and on which exact date, cannot be determined from public records. Its 'last updated' date (7 March 2025) reflects a later edit. Nothing suggests the closure was temporary: CDID continued in a different place instead.

media.caption: 'New Cars' (V4.5).
'New Map Expansion': Desa Cigunung.

sections.heading: The alleged Lemon duplication
sections.label: Community Report
body: A community article published in 2024 claims that a member of the CDID staff passed the V4 game files to someone called 'Lemon', who republished the game, and that Roblox later banned Lemon's copy for stealing someone else's work.

Two community videos from the period make the same allegation in their descriptions: 'CDID was copied by Lemon today' and a call to '#cancelLemon'. One description names a Roblox account. That accusation is unverified and is not reproduced here.

No developer statement, Roblox record or archived page identifying Lemon, the duplicated game or its removal has been found. The alleged insider is not identified in any source, and this archive does not attribute responsibility to anyone.

sections.heading: Grandmini and the V4-labelled copy — not the original
sections.label: Disputed
body: Two different things have been called 'Grandmini' and need to be kept apart.

Place 6267849935 is a separate 'Car Driving Indonesia (Beta)' place, created on 19 January 2021 by the account xxblueknighgxx. It carries a 'CDID V4' changelog, uses a V4 version of the original's icon artwork, and tells players to report admins to the GrandMini group. It is not the original CDID V4: it has 216,610 visits against the original's 5.5 million, a heavily negative rating (58 up / 278 down), and a separate owner. The site owner identifies it as the alleged duplicate. Roblox records, however, show it was created months before 17 May, is still public and was never removed, while the blog says Lemon's copy was banned. Whether it is the 'Lemon' copy is therefore unverified.

The GrandMini Games Studio group is owned by 'pengemudiindo', the same account that owns the original game, and CDID developer Hariaall is its Co-Owner. Roblox's records therefore point to GrandMini being the original team's group, not the duplicate's. That conflicts with the site owner's context, and the disagreement is recorded rather than resolved.

media.caption: Place 6267849935: 'CDID V4' icon (not the original).
Original place 5896294709: 'CDID V4.5' icon.

sections.heading: The reported deletion of an associated account
sections.label: Unverified
body: The site owner reports that the account associated with the incident was deleted. Roblox's public data shows one account in this story in a moderated state: 'pengemudiindo', the owner of the original game and the GrandMini group, whose avatar Roblox returns as 'Blocked'. That status does not show when or why, and it does not mean the account was deleted.

The other accounts — xxblueknighgxx (owner of the V4-labelled copy), Pengemudiindonesiaa (today's CDID owner) and Hariaall — are active. Which account the report refers to cannot be established. A moderated or deleted account is not evidence of who was responsible for anything.

sections.heading: Community reactions and surviving records
sections.label: Community Report
body: Contemporary reactions survive mainly as short YouTube uploads accusing 'Lemon' of copying CDID. Later, the community kept the classic era alive. CDID developer Hariaall republished V2.5, V3.3 and V3.5 as playable archive places, and a creator posting as @beeforiel retold the story on TikTok (not accessible to us).
Original Discord announcements from May 2021, if any exist, could not be read.

sections.heading: The road to CDID V5
sections.label: Verified
body: Development did continue. On 5 June 2021, 19 days after 17 May, a new Car Driving Indonesia was created under the new, verified CDID Studio Official Group. Its owner's display name is 'Pengemudiindo', and Hariaall, who also holds a co-owner role in the old GrandMini group, holds the Developer role in the new one. Its first description announced that 'Car Driving Indonesia (CDID) is back'.

Community sources call this new game 'CDID V5' and say it brought a larger map, an island and a ferry. The developers themselves use the name: the official V2.6.5 changelog (2026) introduced a 'V5 Nostalgia 2026 Map & Event' with twenty '[V5 Nostalgic Edition]' cars.
That V5 was planned as a response to the V4 disappearance, rather than simply following it, is a community account and has not been confirmed by the developers.

media.caption: Today's CDID, in the place created on 5 June 2021.

sections.heading: What remains unverified or unknown
sections.label: Unknown
body: Who 'Lemon' was, and whether the name refers to a person, an account or a group.
The name, Roblox ID and creation date of the alleged duplicate, and whether Roblox removed it.
Whether any CDID staff member was involved. No source names one, and none is implied here.
Why and exactly when the original place closed, and whether by its owner or by Roblox.
Which account the 'deleted account' report refers to.
The contents of the @beeforiel TikTok and of any May 2021 developer announcements.
